title: Clean up names
prompt: clean_names(names) should return a new list with every name stripped of spaces and title-cased. The output looks exactly like the input.
starter:
def clean_names(names):
    # ["  ana ", "BOB"] -> ["Ana", "Bob"]
    cleaned = []
    for n in names:
        n.strip().title()
        cleaned.append(n)
    return cleaned
hints: Print n just after the strip/title line. Did n change?
Strings are immutable: .strip() and .title() return a new string and leave n alone.
Use the value they return: cleaned.append(n.strip().title()).
explanation: str.strip() and str.title() return new strings. The result was thrown away and the original n was appended.
